aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer (not further defined in the abstract).
aggressive_definition_excerpt: We identified 1417 cases among black men (209 advanced), and 28,845 among white men (3898 advanced).
grading_caveat: No grade-based definition is provided; the abstract identifies advanced disease without defining its stage criteria.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall prostate cancer and explicit advanced incident disease. Advanced findings are reported for factors including height, but not for dietary vitamin D.

exposures.supporting_excerpt: The only other evidence of interaction with race was observed for dietary vitamin D intake and non-advanced disease, but only after adjustment for screening (P<sub>interaction</sub> = 0.02).
exposures.reason: The only exposure-specific subtype analysis stated for dietary vitamin D concerns non-advanced disease; the abstract does not establish a vitamin D association analysis for advanced prostate cancer.
